source.tool: MiniMax Music 3 on the workshop ComfyUI (NUC)
source.derivation: trimmed, crossfaded into a seamless loop and two-pass loudnorm to -16 LUFS by tools/make-bgm-loop.py
source.rejected_attempt: The first attempt (max_duration 96 s, empty lyrics) came back at 16.8 s: with no structure the model produced one short idea. Section tags with no words gave it an arrangement to follow and it rendered 113 s.
source.license_name_and_version: see the MiniMax Music 3 model licence — not reviewed

verification.qa: decodes at 110.26 s / 48 kHz / stereo, loops, honours mute (browser check)

assets.note: Instrumental, so nothing competes with the spell cues. The loop is seamless by construction, and verified: the jump at the wrap (0.0144) is SMALLER than the average sample-to-sample step inside the track (0.0206), so it cannot click. The previous track had a hard loop point. Loudness and true-peak limiting are measured on the shipped file, not assumed.

style_pass.supersedes: Q-style chibi in a bright Japanese-cartoon register
style_pass.note: Proportions are unchanged from the previous pass - the same 2.5-head chibi - while the costume, world, palette and UI register moved to a medieval European one. All three passes are kept in art/raw (raw-*, qstyle-*, medieval-*); art/ is 42 MB, which is the cost of being able to re-derive any of them.
